snippet.title: Last Round at the End of the World | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
LAST ROUND at the END OF THE WORLD is an indie folk horror puzzle game where YOU choose who will be sacrificed for the greater good 👁️

- Read the Spirit's poem
- Question the photo-collage villagers
- Play its weird ritual mini-games
- Finally, choose who dies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4746890/Last_Round_at_the_End_of_the_World/ 

Fans of The Wicker Man, Midsommar, and Widow's Bay, the strange island of St. Nineveh and its past eagerly await your visit!

🚨 Play our in-development game, Crow's Requiem, on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3859230/Crows_Requiem

#gamedev #indiedev #horrorgame
